title: RCRA forced thousands of landfills to close. What happened to them?
summary: The federal law raised landfill standards but left it up to states to manage thousands of dumps closed without consistent standards. Now, many sites are left unmonitored despite public health risks.

title: Lessons from Washington’s PCR law, 3 years into enforcement
summary: The policy is successfully spurring the use of recycled plastic, even as thresholds and categories increase, said APR’s Kate Bailey. But some companies, such as Ocean Spray, continue to use no PCR and face penalties.

title: BPI responds to organic compost coalition
summary: The Biodegradable Products Institute defended its petition to allow compostable packaging in organic agriculture, arguing opposition is driven by the waste industry’s use of other types of organic processing technologies.

summary: SPR says its new 42,000-square-foot facility brings its services to a region anticipated to have a wave of end-of-life panels soon. It also aims to meet the state's unique universal waste rules.
